text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Team 'DREAMS,' aiming for total victory at the BC.
As comrades who will challenge this dream together,
everyone introduced themselves once again!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hey, how about doing a stream as a team?
I want to introduce you all to the channel members as the
comrades who deliver "love" to the world, you know?♪

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Becoming teammates with all of you
must surely be divine guidance... Fufu,
let us strive together to overcome our trials.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Yay, 'sup~♪ To beat the world, synergy with your teammates is a total must, right? So first off... wanna grab lunch together?
